name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Karen Moon and David Moon, married six years by the time you arrived. She was out of work, he was a shelf stacker. Money was the thing your parents argued about after you went to bed. You were the youngest of 3: Sergei and Susan were already running the house. Your grandmother Sofia raised four children alone and had no patience for giving up. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Karen Moon and David Moon — a struggling household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.

scene.label: The night shoot
scene.hint: The window is small and it is getting smaller.
scene.title: Paper Cousin
scene.line: Third night in a row. It is four in the morning, the rain machine is on, and nobody has said a kind word since Tuesday.
scene.page: Today's pages: the middle of it — it is too late to be fair about it.
